Package net.ygbstudio.jbrave.api.response

package net.ygbstudio.jbrave.api.response
Sealed response model returned by the Brave Search API.

The root ApiResponse interface permits exactly one implementation per search vertical (web, image, news, video, suggest, spellcheck) plus an ErrorResponse for API errors. Implementations provide JSON (de)serialization helpers so responses can be read from, and written to, strings, files, readers, and HTTP response bodies.

Author:
Yoham Gabriel Barboza B. (YGBStudio)
